entries.evidence: First-import fit pass: Fit pass, connector-by-number, land provenance D-9 with the D-23 hand-solder lengthening: Vincent hand-drawn symbol Conn_BB35K_RA18 and land DDK_BB35K-RA18-3A_2x09_P0.35mm_PowerPin2_Vertical, iphone-x-shim 82bdf4d (designer: owner). Symbol bytes unchanged (70e4a505). Land 21645891 (was 04c19c07): every one of the 24 pad rects is 0.2 mm longer at its outer end only (truedepth-shim D-23, Vincent hand-solders J4200/J4530: 'hand solder so make the pads longer slightly...'): signal 0.18 x 0.545 at y +-0.98, tab side 0.6 x 0.525 at y +-0.985, tab end 0.47 x 1.2 at x +-2.975; width, pitch, inner ends and pad numbers kept; courtyard +-3.4 x +-1.4, silk end lines x +-3.4 and pin-1 tick 0.2 out with the pads (silk-to-pad 0.13 kept), F.Fab body unchanged. 20 passive pins = the land's 20 electrical pad numbers: 1-18 odd/even rows, 19 = DVDD tab at the 1/2 end, 20 = GND tab at the 17/18 end, D-12 (2). Each new rect contains the old one, so 24/24 STEP feet (f6623505, unchanged) stay on their own pads. DRC of the land alone: 16 neighbour gaps of 0.17 mm from his 0.35 pitch (identical on the D-9 land), clean at 0.17 and the jlcpcb_6l floor. Outer ends exceed FB35K catalogue p4 on purpose (D-23). QA unit 1 page c0e933f1 read: numbers and labels clear. Promotion rewrites the Footprint nick iPhoneX: to central-agent:. Re-admission by library-inspector-41b1e4, t-851aa0.
